hero.title: Hong Kong International Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show 2027 – Meet Uniglo Diamonds
hero.lead: Hong Kong International Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show 2027 – Meet Uniglo Diamonds
hero.para1: The Hong Kong International Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show 2027 takes place from 2 to 6 March at AsiaWorld-Expo in Hong Kong. Organised by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council, the international sourcing exhibition connects suppliers of loose diamonds, coloured gemstones, pearls and jewellery-making materials with professional buyers from around the world.
hero.para2: Uniglo Diamonds is preparing to return with a selected natural-diamond portfolio. Buyers can meet the team to examine available stones and discuss individually graded diamonds, fancy shapes, matched pairs, calibrated selections and repeat manufacturing requirements.
hero.para3: Uniglo Diamonds' 2027 hall and stand number have not yet been officially confirmed. The location will be added to this page when current exhibitor information becomes available.

whatIs.title: What Is the Hong Kong International Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show?
whatIs.para1: This HKTDC exhibition concentrates on loose materials used to create fine jewellery. It is designed for professional buyers researching diamonds, coloured gemstones, pearls and related jewellery-making materials.
whatIs.para2: This focus distinguishes the event from an exhibition centred primarily on completed jewellery. Manufacturers, wholesalers, designers and retailers can compare materials before deciding how they will be used in bridal, fine-jewellery and commercial collections.
whatIs.para3: The show operates under HKTDC's EXHIBITION+ model, combining the physical exhibition with online sourcing and business-matching periods before and after the event.
whatIs.areasLabel: The show's specialist areas traditionally include:
areas: Loose stone and commercial sourcing areas

whatCanSource.title: What Buyers Can Source at the 2027 Show
whatCanSource.para1: The exhibition brings together suppliers serving different parts of the diamond, gemstone and pearl markets. A productive visit should begin with a clear sourcing objective.
whatCanSource.para2: A bridal retailer may need documented centre stones, while a manufacturer may require calibrated diamonds for repeatable production. A wholesaler might compare commercial parcels, and a designer may be searching for an individual shape or proportion.

twinShows.title: Hong Kong International Jewellery Show & Twin Shows
twinShows.para1: The Hong Kong International Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show and the Hong Kong International Jewellery Show are presented together as the HKTDC Twin Jewellery Shows. However, they are separate exhibitions at different venues.
twinShows.para2: The two exhibitions overlap from 4 to 6 March. Qualified buyers can therefore plan a trip covering raw materials at AsiaWorld-Expo and finished jewellery at HKCEC.
twinShows.para3: Visitors must not assume that both exhibitions are located in the same complex. Appointments at the two venues should not be scheduled close together.

twinShows.venuePara1: AsiaWorld-Expo is located near Hong Kong International Airport on Lantau Island. It hosts the Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show and is the correct venue for buyers primarily sourcing loose diamonds, coloured gemstones, pearls and jewellery materials.
twinShows.venuePara2: The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre is located at 1 Expo Drive in Wan Chai. It hosts the Hong Kong International Jewellery Show and focuses more heavily on finished jewellery and completed collections.

Avoid switching venues repeatedly during one day
Allow substantial travel and security-check time
Check which badge or registration is needed for each exhibition
Carry the identification specified by HKTDC

meet.title: Meet Uniglo Diamonds in Hong Kong
meet.para1: Uniglo Diamonds plans to present natural diamonds for retailers, manufacturers, wholesalers and designers. The final exhibition selection will depend on availability closer to the show.
meet.para2: A meeting should begin with the intended jewellery application and commercial objective. One buyer may need a documented centre stone for a customer commission, while another may require matched earrings, calibrated diamonds or repeatable manufacturing specifications.
meet.para3: Buyers with specific requirements should share them before the show. This allows the team to consider more relevant options where availability permits.
meet.cta: Book a Hong Kong Trade Meeting

sourcing.title: Natural Diamond Sourcing at the Hong Kong Show
sourcing.para1: Diamond sourcing should consider more than a headline carat weight, colour and clarity grade. Measurements, proportions, cutting style, outline and overall visual appearance can affect how effectively a diamond works in the intended jewellery.
sourcing.para2: Two diamonds with similar grading information may differ in face-up dimensions or visual character. This is particularly important with fancy-shaped diamonds, where length-to-width ratio and outline can strongly influence appearance.

bridal.title: Diamonds for Bridal and Fine Jewellery
bridal.para1: Retailers should identify gaps in their existing inventory before the exhibition. These might include a missing shape, carat range, quality combination or commercial price point.
bridal.para2: Manufacturers should provide dimensions for existing mountings and specify any tolerances required for repeatable production.
bridal.discussLabel: Buyers can discuss natural diamonds for:

matching.title: Matching and Calibration
matching.para1: Matching is essential when several diamonds will be used together. Earrings, eternity bands, tennis jewellery and multi-stone designs may require consistency across measurements, shape, colour, clarity and overall appearance.
matching.para2: Required measurements, acceptable tolerances, quantities and intended settings should be provided at the beginning of the sourcing discussion.
matching.imageAlt: Matched and calibrated natural diamonds from Uniglo Diamonds in Hong Kong

measurements.title: Measurements and Proportions
measurements.para1: Carat weight does not provide a complete description of a polished diamond's size. Two stones with the same carat weight can have different dimensions and face-up presence.
measurements.considerLabel: Before an appointment, buyers should identify:
considerItems: Visual preferences not represented fully by a report

certification.title: Grading Reports and Documentation
certification.para1: Documentation needs may vary according to a diamond's size, value, intended market and jewellery application.
certification.para2: Documentation should be agreed before a selection is prepared.
considerItems: Whether individual grading reports are required
Whether documents must accompany each stone
Requirements for matched pairs or calibrated layouts

inPerson.title: Why Examine Natural Diamonds in Person?
inPerson.para1: Online inventory information helps buyers begin their research, but direct examination can reveal characteristics that are difficult to judge from data or standard photography.
inPerson.para2: An in-person discussion can also help buyers understand how a supplier communicates, evaluates specifications and handles follow-up requirements.
inPerson.assessLabel: At the exhibition, buyers may be able to compare:
inPerson.imageAlt: Hybrid natural-diamond sourcing at the Hong Kong show

hybrid.title: Click2Match & Online Sourcing
hybrid.para1: The physical exhibition is supported by HKTDC's EXHIBITION+ format. This extends sourcing activity beyond the five days at AsiaWorld-Expo.
hybrid.para2: The online platform supports the physical event rather than replacing it. Natural diamonds and gemstones may still benefit from direct examination before an important purchasing or supply decision.
hybrid.para3: Buyers using digital inventories should record stock references, grading-report numbers and requirements they want to examine during an appointment.
benefits: Arrange meetings before the physical exhibition
Contact suppliers they could not meet in person
Follow up on specifications and documentation

planning.title: Planning Your Visit
planning.para1: The exhibition is intended for professional buyers and jewellery-industry participants. Visitors should complete the appropriate HKTDC registration and review the current admission conditions before travelling.
planning.para2: HKTDC offers digital registration and buyer e-badge facilities. Visitors should follow the current instructions for account verification, document submission, badge activation and identity checks.
planItems: Confirm that the registration has been approved
Review current e-badge and identification requirements
Check whether separate registration is needed for both shows
Plan travel between AsiaWorld-Expo and HKCEC
Check current transport and shuttle information
Use Click2Match before and after the physical show

partnerships.title: Relationships Built Through Informed Sourcing
partnerships.para1: International exhibitions create opportunities to meet new suppliers, but strong sourcing relationships require more than an initial introduction. Consistency, transparency, communication and dependable service all become important once the exhibition ends.
partnerships.para2: After meeting Uniglo Diamonds, buyers may wish to request a focused selection, review grading reports, refine requirements or confirm production schedules.
partnerships.para3: These conversations help Uniglo Diamonds understand how demand differs between markets while continuing to support buyers with natural diamonds selected for real commercial requirements.

items.question: When is the Hong Kong International Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show 2027?
items.answer: The physical exhibition will take place from Tuesday, 2 March through Saturday, 6 March 2027.

items.question: Where will the show be held?
items.answer: It will be held at AsiaWorld-Expo, 1 Airport Expo Boulevard, Chek Lap Kok, Lantau Island, Hong Kong.

items.question: What are the visitor opening hours?
items.answer: The currently published schedule lists 10:30–18:30 on 2 March, 10:00–18:30 from 3 to 5 March and 10:00–17:30 on 6 March. Visitors should check for updates before travelling.

items.question: What can buyers source at the exhibition?
items.answer: The show focuses on loose diamonds, coloured gemstones, pearls, laboratory-grown diamonds and other jewellery-making materials.

items.question: Is this the same as the Hong Kong International Jewellery Show?
items.answer: No. The Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show is held at AsiaWorld-Expo from 2–6 March and focuses mainly on loose materials. The International Jewellery Show is held at HKCEC from 4–8 March and focuses mainly on finished jewellery.

items.question: What are the HKTDC Twin Jewellery Shows?
items.answer: The name refers collectively to the Hong Kong International Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show and the Hong Kong International Jewellery Show. The exhibitions are held at separate venues.

items.question: Do the two HKTDC exhibitions overlap?
items.answer: Yes. Both physical shows operate from 4 to 6 March 2027. Buyers attending both should allow sufficient travel time between AsiaWorld-Expo and HKCEC.

items.question: Is this the same as Jewellery & Gem WORLD Hong Kong?
items.answer: No. Jewellery & Gem WORLD Hong Kong is a separate Informa Markets event normally held in September. This page covers the HKTDC Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show held in March.

items.question: Is the exhibition open to the general public?
items.answer: It is a trade-focused sourcing exhibition. Visitors should review HKTDC's current buyer eligibility and registration requirements before making travel arrangements.

items.question: What identification is required?
items.answer: Visitors should follow the identity and e-badge instructions provided with their 2027 registration. The required original identification should be carried when attending.

items.question: When is Click2Match available?
items.answer: The currently published Click2Match period runs from 23 February to 13 March 2027.

items.question: What is the wider online sourcing period?
items.answer: HKTDC currently lists the online sourcing extension from 2 February to 1 April 2027.

items.question: What is Uniglo Diamonds' stand number?
items.answer: Uniglo Diamonds' 2027 hall and stand number have not yet been officially confirmed. This page will be updated when the information becomes available.

items.question: What natural diamonds can buyers discuss with Uniglo Diamonds?
items.answer: Buyers can discuss Round Brilliant and fancy-shaped natural diamonds across different sizes, measurements, colours and clarities. Requirements may include individual documented stones, matched pairs, calibrated selections and diamonds for repeat production.

items.question: Should buyers arrange a meeting in advance?
items.answer: Advance booking is recommended for buyers with specific requirements. Providing shapes, measurements, quality ranges, quantities and documentation expectations will help the team plan a more relevant discussion.

finalCta.title: Book a Meeting with Uniglo Diamonds
finalCta.para: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at the Hong Kong International Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show to explore natural diamonds and Antwerp-based sourcing possibilities for your business. When requesting an appointment, provide your preferred shapes, carat or measurement ranges, colours, clarities, quantities, grading-report requirements and intended jewellery applications.
